H4150.gloss: appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast, (appointed, due) season, solemn…
H4150.def: properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally ayear; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand)

H4191.gloss: [idiom] at all, [idiom] crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like…
H4191.def: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill

H4100.gloss: how (long, oft, (-soever)), (no-) thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby(-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why.
H4100.def: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses

H4111.def: Mahalalel, the name of an antediluvian patriarch and of an Israelite

H4172.gloss: dread, (that ought to be) fear(-ed), terribleness, terror.
H4172.def: fear; by implication, a fearful thing or deed

H4186.gloss: assembly, dwell in, dwelling(-place), wherein (that) dwelt (in), inhabited place, seat, sitting, situation, sojourning.
H4186.def: a seat; figuratively, a site; abstractly, a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population

H4138.def: nativity (plural birth-place); by implication, lineage, native country; also offspring, family

H4176.def: Moreh, a Canaanite; also a hill (perhaps named from him)

H4135.gloss: circumcise(-ing), selves), cut down (in pieces), destroy, [idiom] must needs.
H4135.def: to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise); by implication, to blunt; figuratively, to destroy

H4116.gloss: be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste(-n, -ily), (be) hasty, (fetch, make ready) [idiom] quickl…
H4116.def: properly, to be liquid or flow easily, i.e. (by implication); to hurry (in a good or a bad sense); often used (with another verb) adverbially, promptly

H4102.def: properly, to question or hesitate, i.e. (by implication) to be reluctant

H4124.def: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants

H4194.def: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin

H4159.def: a miracle; by implication, a token or omen

H4170.def: a noose (for catching animals) (literally or figuratively); by implication, a hook (for the nose)

H4185.gloss: cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.
H4185.def: to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive)

H4127.gloss: consume, dissolve, (be) faint(-hearted), melt (away), make soft.
H4127.def: to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint)

H4142.gloss: being changed, inclosed, be set, turning.
H4142.def: a reversal, i.e. the backside (of a gem), fold (of a double-leaved door), transmutation (of a name)

H4118.gloss: hasteth, hastily, at once, quickly, soon, speedily, suddenly.

H4136.gloss: (over) against, before, (fore-) front, from, (God-) ward, toward, with.
H4136.def: properly, abrupt, i.e. a precipice; by implication, the front; used only adverbially (with prepositional prefix) opposite

H4134.def: to become thin, i.e. (figuratively) be impoverished

H4133.def: a pole; by implication, an ox-bow; hence, a yoke (either literal or figurative)

H4171.def: to alter; by implication, to barter, to dispose of

H4188.def: a Mushite (collectively) or descendants of Mushi

H4132.def: a wavering, i.e. fall; by implication, a pole (as shaking); hence, a yoke (as essentially a bent pole)

H4161.gloss: brought out, bud, that which came out, east, going forth, goings out, that which (thing that) is gone out, outgoing, pr…
H4161.def: a going forth, i.e. (the act) an egress, or (the place) an exit; hence, a source or product; specifically, dawn, the rising of the sun (the East), exportation, utterance, a gate, a fountain, a mine, a meadow (as producing grass)

H4125.def: a Moabite or Moabitess, i.e. a descendant from Moab

H4103.gloss: destruction, discomfiture, trouble, tumult, vexation, vexed.

H4149.def: Moserah or Moseroth, a place in the Desert

H4148.gloss: bond, chastening(-eth), chastisement, check, correction, discipline, doctrine, instruction, rebuke.
H4148.def: properly, chastisement; figuratively, reproof, warning or instruction; also restraint

H4120.gloss: hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, make (with) speed(-ily), swiftly.

H4131.gloss: be carried, cast, be out of course, be fallen in decay, [idiom] exceedingly, fall(-ing down), be (re-) moved, be ready,…
H4131.def: to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall

H4174.gloss: going down, steep place, thin work.
H4174.def: a descent; as architecture, an ornamental appendage, perhaps a festoon

H4165.def: properly, fusion, i.e. literally, a casting (of metal); figuratively, a mass (of clay)

H4101.gloss: how great (mighty), that which, what(-soever), why.
H4101.def: {properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what}

H4109.def: a walk, i.e. a passage or a distance

H4105.def: Mehetabel, the name of an Edomitish man and woman

H4147.def: properly, chastisement, i.e. (by implication) a halter; figuratively, restraint

H4154.def: properly, made to slip, i.e. dislocated

H4107.def: properly, to cut down or reduce, i.e. by implication, to adulterate

H4122.def: Maher-Shalal-Chash-Baz; the symbolical name of the son of Isaiah

H4151.def: properly, an assembly figuratively, a troop

H4168.def: a fire or fuel; abstractly, a conflagration

H4158.def: Mophaath or Mephaath, a place in Palestine

H4166.def: properly, something poured out, i.e. a casting (of metal); by implication, a tube (as cast)
